name: Teelu Rauteli Pension Scheme
benefit: - A pension of ₹1,200/- per month is provided to each eligible beneficiary.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be male or female engaged in agricultural activities. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must be 20% to 40% disabled while performing agricultural work. 1. There is no income limit to avail the benefits of the scheme.
